title: Video Recording - 1/2-in Type H - Cassette, Tape and Records
scope: This standard specifies the characteristics and parameters for type H, helical-scan, 1/2-in video tape recorders operating with video signals as defined by ITU-R BT.470 and ANSI/SMPTE 170M, and having a typical scanning structure of 525 lines, 59.94 fields per second, and 2:1 interlace. This standard also specifies the double record time mode (long play, LP) and the triple record time mode (extended play, EP), and optional frequency modulation (FM) audio recording. This standard further specifies the dimensions of the video tape and compact video cassette for use in a type H, helical-scan, 1/2-in video tape recording cassette system with the aid of a cassette adaptor. Finally, this standard specifies the characteristics and parameters for high-performance type H, helicalscan, 1/2-in video tape recorders operating with video signals as defined by ITU-R BT.470 and ANSI/SMPTE 170M, and having a typical scanning structure of 525 lines, 59.94 fields per second, and 2:1 interlace.
